@auth/core.reason: Transitive via next-auth 4.24.15 (latest v4). Advisories concern the Email provider normalizer and getToken() on malformed Bearer headers; MixoGuide uses neither (no Email provider; bearer tokens are decoded via next-auth/jwt decode in mobile-auth.service). npm's suggested 'fix' is a downgrade. Resolve by migrating to Auth.js v5 (backlog BL-19).

next-auth.reason: Flagged only because of its @auth/core dependency (see above).

prisma.reason: Prisma CLI config loader (@prisma/config -> effect, deepmerge-ts). Runs only at build/migration time on trusted config, not on request data. Fix requires Prisma 7 major upgrade (backlog BL-19).

zod.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. Partially mitigated: request arrays carry .max() bounds; JSON body size is not capped in the app, so set a reverse-proxy body limit (docs/RUNBOOK.md). Fix requires zod 4 major upgrade across web + shared schemas (backlog BL-19).
